definition: Generating cooking recipes — ingredients and step-by-step instructions — from a title, photo, or ingredient list.
details: Generating cooking recipes — ingredients and step-by-step instructions — from a title, photo, or ingredient list. It tests a model’s ability to produce structured, procedurally coherent text.

explainer.lead: Recipe generation is the task of producing cooking recipes, ingredients and step-by-step instructions, from a title, photo, or ingredient list. It matters as a test of structured, procedurally coherent text generation.

tiers.eli5: Like handing a model a photo of a dish and asking it to write the recipe as if it had cooked it.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to probe whether a model can keep both a structured ingredient list and steps in a workable order. A pitfall is fluent prose that is procedurally incoherent, such as steps referencing ingredients never listed.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as generating recipes, ingredients plus step-by-step instructions, conditioned on a title, image, or ingredient list. It evaluates structured, procedurally coherent text output.

explainer.example: Given the title of a soup, the model outputs an ingredient list and ordered steps that reference those ingredients.
